title: The Old Soldier's Grave
text: A cairn by the road with a rusted helm on top, and words scratched deep into the rock beneath it: FOR THE ONE WHO PUT THE SWORD DOWN AND PICKED IT UP AGAIN. The stones are clean of moss. Someone has been tending it.

options.label: The one it names kneels at the cairn, feeling the words were carved for them.

outcomes.text: They stand up with an old soldier's patience settled in them, slow and sure.
They stand up older, with grey in their hair that was not there before. The soldier gave what he had, and took a little back.

options.label: Pass by without stopping. The dead have had their due.

outcomes.text: The helm turns to watch you go, and every hand on a sword feels heavier for not stopping.
The helm turns to watch you go, and nods once. Some old soldier is satisfied, and you march the straighter for it.

options.label: The Soldier lays their sword on the cairn, and takes it up again, as the words ask.

outcomes.text: The words were meant for them. The helm nods, and the blade comes away from the cairn truer than it went down.
